articles.title: 2026’s Words of the Year, So Far
articles.summary: It can be difficult to sum up a year in a word, but that hasn’t stopped dictionaries from trying. Last year , they picked terms like “rage bait,” “AI slop,” and even the slang 67 (pronounced six-seven), in attempts to capture the cultural zeitgeist. articles.title: The Altruists Rewrites the FTX Collapse as an Implausible Dangerous Liaisons for Nerds
articles.summary: In the four years since FTX collapsed —and the three since the cryptocurrency exchange’s founder, Sam Bankman-Fried , was convicted on multiple fraud charges —its downfall has been squeezed to fit many narrative frames. It’s the Emperor’s New Clothes or Icarus flying too close to the sun. Or maybe it’s a cautionary tale about Bankman-Fried’s guiding philosophy, effective altruism , which encourages adherents to maximize charitable giving by earning a lot of money. articles.title: Pawan Kumar Chandana Is Taking India’s Private Space Industry to New Heights
articles.summary: The eyes of a nation were on the sleek, blue and white, 72-ft. tall Vikram-1 rocket when it zipped off its launchpad in Andhra Pradesh, India, on July 18, 2026, carrying half a dozen small satellites to low-Earth orbit 280 miles up. It was the first time the world’s most populous nation orbited a payload launched by a privately built and owned rocket, and Prime Minister Narenda Modi was making the most of it. articles.title: Alia Bhatt Is Defining Stardom on Her Own Terms
articles.summary: At first, Alia Bhatt ’s arrival was met with a degree of cynicism. Here was another daughter of Bollywood privilege—her parents are the filmmaker Mahesh Bhatt and the actor Soni Razdan—this time, asserting her magnetic presence in the 2012 film Student of the Year . A turning point arrived just two years later. In Imtiaz Ali’s 2014 film Highway , she played Veera Tripathi, a woman who goes on an unexpected voyage of self-discovery after being abducted.
